description: This file defines a centralized API client using Axios for a frontend application. It includes configuration for API requests, interceptors for handling authorization and errors, and exports multiple API modules (AuthAPI, UserAPI, RecipeAPI, MealPlanAPI, SocialAPI, PremiumAPI) that encapsulate various backend endpoints related to authentication, user management, recipes, meal planning, social features, and premium subscriptions.

methods.name: loginEmail
methods.description: Performs email/password login, returns token and user data.

methods.name: registerEmail
methods.description: Performs email registration, returns token and user data.

methods.name: requestPasswordReset
methods.description: Triggers a password reset email for the specified email.

methods.name: socialLogin
methods.description: Handles OAuth/social login callback exchange, returns token and user data.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user profile data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user session.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates user profile fields.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates user password securely.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deactivates or deletes the user account.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Sets user dietary preferences and allergies.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches recipes with filters such as query, ingredients, diets, and page.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new recipe with provided payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe identified by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a recipe by ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Bookmarks or saves a recipe.

methods.name: unsave
methods.description: Removes a recipe from bookmarks.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Rates and reviews a recipe.

methods.name: recommendations
methods.description: Fetches personalized recipe recommendations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves meal plan for specified period and start date.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Assigns a recipe to a specific date and meal type in the meal plan.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes a meal plan entry by its ID.

methods.name: savePlan
methods.description: Saves the current meal plan snapshot with a given name.

methods.name: groceryList
methods.description: Generates a grocery list for a specified date range.

methods.name: follow
methods.description: Follows another user.

methods.name: unfollow
methods.description: Unfollows a user.

methods.name: feed
methods.description: Retrieves social activity feed.

methods.name: shareRecipe
methods.description: Shares a recipe to external services or within app.

methods.name: communities
methods.description: Lists or joins communities.

methods.name: joinCommunity
methods.description: Joins a specified community.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Gets the current user's premium subscription status.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the user to a premium plan.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the user's premium subscription.
